limits: Two alternative scenarios, not joint capital.

comparison.limits: Shared signal time is an identity comparison, not random paired trades or assignment of PnL to14cancelledorders. Delta is two complete simulated policies, not per-fill causal effects.

source_field_definitions.sources.*.observed_max_R: Median of per-trade observed maxima; not global maximum.
